batch: PSScriptTools runtime-probe ThreadJob dependency path correction
finding: The package install directory is named microsoft-powershell-threadjob and contains Microsoft.PowerShell.ThreadJob.psd1 at its root. Adding that leaf directory to PSModulePath does not make the RequiredModules entry discoverable by PowerShell. A synthetic module-metadata check reproduced the failure without loading upstream source.

Do not modify PSModulePath.
